text.zh_CN: 设想你持有的一家公司刚刚派息：你没有卖出任何一股股票，现金却增加了。这就是经营现金流——一家真实创造利润的企业，在按期与股东分享成果。
text.en: Imagine one of your holdings just paid a dividend: you didn't sell a single share, yet cash arrived. That is operating cash flow — a real business sharing genuine profits with shareholders.

text.zh_CN: 年化两三个点？太慢了。我今天早盘抓一次动量突破就拿了四个点。等你们靠股息滚出复利，这轮牛市早散场了。
text.en: Two or three percent annualized? Painfully slow. I locked four points on a single momentum breakout this morning. By the time you compound dividends, the bull run is long gone.

text.zh_CN: 市场里最快的钱，通常也最快离开。慢不等于平庸，它意味着你不需要每天靠心跳去赌方向。现在这笔现金在你手里，你打算怎么分配？
text.en: The fastest money in the market usually leaves the fastest. Slow isn't mediocre; it means you don't need daily adrenaline to survive. Now that the cash is here, how do you handle it?

text.zh_CN: 关于这笔现金分红，你的策略是？
text.en: What is your dividend allocation strategy?

text.zh_CN: 设定红利再投资（DRIP），让复利滚雪球。
text.en: Set dividend reinvestment (DRIP) to compound the snowball.

toast.zh_CN: 确立策略：红利自动再投资

text.zh_CN: 留作防守现金储备，等待估值便宜时加仓。
text.en: Keep as defensive cash reserve, waiting for bargains.

toast.zh_CN: 确立策略：保留现金防守

text.zh_CN: 经典的复利思维。它在短期内极其安静甚至乏味，但在十年后，几何级数的复利会把追涨杀跌的人远远甩在身后。
text.en: Classic compounding mindset. It is quiet and almost boring in the short run, but after a decade, exponential growth leaves traders far behind.

text.zh_CN: 克制而理性的储备。流动性就是你的干粮与子弹。当狂热消退、恐慌杀跌时，只有手握现金的人才有从容扫货的底气。
text.en: Disciplined and calculated. Liquidity is your dry powder. When euphoria fades and panic strikes, only those with cash can scoop up bargains with composure.

text.zh_CN: 去持仓页看看分红与除息记录在哪里。从今天起，别只盯价格的上下跳动，学会去读懂现金流的脉搏。
text.en: Open the Portfolio tab and find where dividends and ex-dividend entries are recorded. From today on, don't just stare at price ticks; learn to feel the pulse of cash flow.
